title: Khuda ke Ghar Me Ali ka Lahu Bahaya Gaya
body:
1. Quda Ke Ghar Mein Ali Ka Lahoo Bahaya Gaya.
Lehed Mein Binte Muhammed Sa., Ko Yun Rulaya Gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tadap Raha Hai Musalle Pe Fatahe Khaibar.
Sare Imam Pe Sajde Mein Zulm Dhaaya Gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Janaza Jaan Ke Baba Ka Cheeq Uthi Zainab Sa.
Ali Asws. Ko Masjid E Koofa Se Aise Laaya Gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Salaam Bhi Nahi Karta Tha Koi Hyder Asws., Ko.
Har Aik Gaam Pe Moula Ka Dil Dukhaya Gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dame Aqeer Bhi Yeh Kehke Ro Rahe The Ali Asws,.
Meri Batool Sa., Ko Darbaar Mein Bulaya Gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kumail Aagayi Asghar Asws., Ki Yaad Moula Ko.
Jo Doodh Koozo'N Mein Bharkar Unhe Pilaya Gaya.
